cat.description: The given items are concatenated, where each one takes one cycle.

seq.description: Like cat, but the items are crammed into one cycle.

stack.description: The given items are played at the same time at the same length.

stepcat.description: 'Concatenates' patterns like fastcat, but proportional to a number of steps per cycle.

arrange.description: Allows to arrange multiple patterns together over multiple cycles.

polymeter.description: Aligns the steps of the patterns, creating polymeters.

run.description: A discrete pattern of numbers from 0 to n-1

binary.description: Creates a pattern from a binary number.
params: n (number): input number to convert to binary

binaryn.description: Creates a pattern from a binary number, padded to n bits long.
params: n (number): input number to convert to binary

slow.description: Slow down a pattern over the given number of cycles.

fast.description: Speed up a pattern by the given factor.

early.description: Nudge a pattern to start earlier in time.
params: cycles (number|Pattern): number of cycles to nudge left

late.description: Nudge a pattern to start later in time.
params: cycles (number|Pattern): number of cycles to nudge right

cliplegatoclip.description: Multiplies the duration with the given number. Also cuts samples off at the end if they exceed the duration.

euclid.description: Changes the structure of the pattern to form an Euclidean rhythm.
params: steps (number): the number of steps to fill

euclidrot.description: Like euclid, but has an additional parameter for 'rotating' the resulting sequence.
params: steps (number): the number of steps to fill

euclidlegato.description: Similar to euclid, but each pulse is held until the next pulse, so there will be no gaps.

rev.description: Reverse all haps in a pattern

palindrome.description: Applies rev to a pattern every other cycle.

iter.description: Divides a pattern into a given number of subdivisions, plays the subdivisions in order, but increments the starting subdivision each cycle.

iterback.description: Like iter, but plays the subdivisions in reverse order.

ply.description: The ply function repeats each event the given number of times.

segment.description: Samples the pattern at a rate of n events per cycle.
params: segments (number): number of segments per cycle

compress.description: Compress each cycle into the given timespan, leaving a gap

zoom.description: Plays a portion of a pattern, specified by the beginning and end of a time span.

linger.description: Selects the given fraction of the pattern and repeats that part to fill the remainder of the cycle.

fastgap.description: speeds up a pattern like fast, but rather than it playing multiple times as fast would it instead leaves a gap.

inside.description: Carries out an operation 'inside' a cycle.

outside.description: Carries out an operation 'outside' a cycle.

cpm.description: Plays the pattern at the given cycles per minute.

ribbon.description: Loops the pattern inside an offset for cycles.
params: offset (number): start point of loop in cycles

swingby.description: Delays events in the second half of each slice by the amount x.

add.description: Adds the given number to each item in the pattern.

sub.description: Like add, but the given numbers are subtracted.

mul.description: Multiplies each number by the given factor.

div.description: Divides each number by the given factor.

round.description: Returns a new pattern with all values rounded to the nearest integer.

floor.description: Returns a new pattern with all values set to their mathematical floor.

ceil.description: Returns a new pattern with all values set to their mathematical ceiling.

range.description: Returns a new pattern with values scaled to the given min/max range (from 0..1).

rangex.description: Returns a new pattern with values scaled to the given min/max range, following an exponential curve.

range2.description: Returns a new pattern with values scaled to the given min/max range (from -1..1).

ratio.description: Allows dividing numbers via list notation using ":".

params: mapping (String|Array): the control names that are set

begin.description: Skips the beginning of each sample.

end.description: Cuts off the end off each sample.

params: on (number|Pattern): If 1, the sample is looped

loopbegin.description: Begin to loop at a specific point in the sample.

loopend.description: End the looping section at a specific point in the sample.

cut.description: Cut will stop a playing sample as soon as another samples with in same cutgroup is to be played.

loopat.description: Makes the sample fit the given number of cycles by changing the speed.

fit.description: Makes the sample fit its event duration.

chop.description: Cuts each sample into the given number of parts.

striate.description: Cuts each sample into the given number of parts, triggering progressive portions.

slice.description: Chops samples into the given number of slices, triggering those slices with a given pattern.

splice.description: Works the same as slice, but changes the playback speed of each slice.

scrub.description: Allows you to scrub an audio file like a tape loop.

speed.description: Changes the speed of sample playback.

basicwaveforms.description: s, sound Selects the sound/synth to use.
params: sound (string): sine, sawtooth, square, triangle, or sample name

noise.description: noise Adds noise to the sound.

vib.description: vibrato, v, vib Applies a vibrato to the frequency of the oscillator.
params: frequency (number|Pattern): of the vibrato in hertz

vibmod.description: vmod Sets the vibrato depth in semitones.

fm.description: fmi Sets the Frequency Modulation of the synth.

fmh.description: Sets the Frequency Modulation Harmonicity Ratio.

fmattack.description: Attack time for the FM envelope.

fmdecay.description: Decay time for the FM envelope.

fmsustain.description: Sustain level for the FM envelope.

note.description: note Sets the note to play.
params: note (string|number): note name or midi number

gain.description: gain Sets the volume of the sound.

cutoff.description: cutoff Sets the filter cutoff frequency.
